findings.highlight: If I give him an opening, he'll pulverize my brain before I can use Saber's sword.
findings.evidenceJa: そんな隙を見せれば、セイバーの剣を作る前に頭蓋を砕かれている。
findings.governingReading: He would have his skull smashed before creating Saber's sword if he exposed the Projection opening.
findings.explanation: Interruption before sword creation becomes before sword use.

findings.evidenceJa: 人間の敵である“この世全ての悪”なんていうモノを容認するのか。
findings.governingReading: Narration asks why he permits the curse even at the brink of death.
findings.explanation: On death's door uses the wrong English idiom.

findings.highlight: But if it has no doubts whatsoever about its own existence, it would be good. After all, that is what was wished of it. Something which does not question its own existence cannot possibly be evil."
findings.evidenceJa: だが自らの存在に何の疑問も持たなければ、アレは善だ。なにしろそのように望まれたモノ。自らの機能に疑いを持たぬのであれば、それが悪である筈がない」
findings.governingReading: After the question about existence, he argues that not doubting one's designed function cannot be evil.
findings.explanation: Doubt about one's function becomes repeated doubt about existence.

findings.highlight: It is a wish of the same nature, yet the antithesis to you, who has no wish to return to yourself.
findings.evidenceJa: 自身に還る望みを持たぬおまえと対極に位置する、同質の願望だ」
findings.governingReading: Shirou has no wish whose satisfaction returns something to himself; Kirei's opposite yet similar desire concerns himself.
findings.explanation: No wish returning benefit to oneself becomes no wish to return to oneself.

findings.highlight: "...Hmph. I should say, I feel sentimental having confessed this.
findings.evidenceJa: 「……ふん。それにな、告白すれば感傷でもある。
findings.governingReading: Kirei admits that his motive also involves sentiment.
findings.explanation: If I confess this becomes sentiment caused by having confessed.

findings.highlight: His life brought only death to anything he obtained.
findings.evidenceJa: そうして得たものは死を運ぶという生き方のみ。
findings.governingReading: What he gained was only a way of living that brings death; next he cannot abandon that one possession.
findings.explanation: Acquiring only a death-bearing way of life becomes killing anything he acquired.

findings.highlight: I run and make a beeline at my opponent.
findings.evidenceJa: 地を蹴り、一直線に“敵”は敵を討ちに迫る。
findings.governingReading: The enemy charges straight in; Shirou lacks that leg power and lowers himself for a counter against the approaching opponent.

findings.highlight: The enemy I attacked with such speed and power disappears from sight.
findings.evidenceJa: あの速度。あの勢いで襲撃した敵は、一瞬で視界から消え去り、
findings.governingReading: The enemy who assaulted him with that speed disappears from view, folds to his left, and strikes.
findings.explanation: Enemy who attacked at speed becomes enemy Shirou attacked.

findings.highlight: Kotomine has the overwelming edge in close-combat skills.
findings.evidenceJa: 格闘技術において、言峰は俺を遥かに上回っている。
findings.governingReading: Kotomine has an overwhelming close-combat advantage.
